title: Chronicles of Depression
overview: Set within the confines of a 1950s psychiatric hospital, the film unfolds through a series of recorded patient interviews that gradually uncover a deeply disturbing reality hidden beneath the institution’s calm exterior. As fractured testimonies begin to overlap, a sinister presence known only as the “Shadow Man” emerges from the darkness at the centre of the hospital’s experiments.
